text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- French parliamentary and trade delegation to visit Baghdad at beginning of November.
- Libyan education minister arrives in Baghdad.
- Egypt reopens trade centre in Iraq.
- South Korean firms ready to start work in Iraq.
(Above stories were also carried by THAWRA and QADISSIYA)
- Iran frees 150 Iraqi prisoners of war.
- Iraq authorises ministries of defence and interior and military intelligence and security forces to seize items intended to be smuggled out of country.
